reuse_applicability: Prior results retain their original successful supervisor, worker, source/config/runtime and full reproducible snapshots. source_clock_contract.clock_claim: Named BBO-stream alternative only. No reconstructed receipt clock, snapshot generation time or exchange chronology.
source_clock_contract.continuation: Original terminal row and source identity remain separate from non-replay chronological highwater; original policy/adjacency state is bound into source and measurement carry and quote replay.
source_clock_contract.economic_state: No book recovery, fresh quote, OFI, trade, dwell or economic quote age reset from disposed records. Preserve blocked/trust state. Count replay raw occupancy in its original native bin so it cannot create falsely quiet eligible coverage.
source_clock_contract.qualification: Backward A/N/168 after adjacent same-source same-instrument A/M/C with flags128or132 and exact equal valid BBO. Gap flags132 and first invalidation remain effective; no recovery or fresh age inferred. Resets, changed BBO and ordinary backward clocks remain errors.
source_clock_contract.raw_preservation: Keep every original field/timestamp/address/order/hash and all raw and snapshot counters. Only a proven BBO-redundant snapshot is absent from the economic quote and temporal-raw view; this is not an order-level duplicate claim.

source_continuation: Adjacent completed intervals of the exact explicit source lineage. Preserve global original row order, first invalidation and separate prefix-flow completeness, standing quote event/age and bounded trade dwell. A new local measurement anchor does not recover the book.
source_instrument_inventory: All original relevant group IDs and flags footers; constant/non-null ID proof unchanged. Attained non-snapshot flag endpoints establish possible earlier ownership, snapshot-only groups cannot change ownership. Unproved cases retain every file ID. Resource metadata only, never a selector.
source_quality_terminology: gap_rows is the count of retained records carrying provider F_MAYBE_BAD_BOOK, not missing records, files or separate outages. Book reinitialization remains a distinct pending source-semantics comparison, with the existing behavior unchanged in this check.
source_reference_policy: Compare all nine complete check-9 raw/event/native populations, all original atomic/whole/TPO/coordinate/coverage measurements and complete continuation state. This also exercises decoding of accepted ask-minus-bid v1 descriptors after rejection of that encoder optimization. Native floating-integral tolerances remain 1e-6 absolute/1e-12 relative. Complete original canonical JSON bytes must equal current restricted-domain bytes.
source_schedule: Every original source/day remains scheduled. Bound raw allocations by selected-group IDs plus all possible earlier ordinary owners. The reader batch allowance is ceiling(physical rows/65536) plus the intervening selected row-group boundaries, checked against actual decoder output before publication. Check 4 underestimated reader batches by omitting those boundary splits.
storage_encoding_candidate: Original trade/native structural Parquet plus full-source verified quote replay descriptors; exact source and quote values retained. Replay validation CPU and descriptor storage included.
throughput_scope: Seventeen held-out complete UTC days from distinct original files. Source/native/measurement/verified quote replay and actual allocation/contention; no full family, Context or Location completion.
